goal: Allow transactions with non-standard script flags into test network mempools with -acceptnonstdtxn=1
Let developers test future soft forks and experimental opcodes without mining them directly into blocks
agreement: Broad support for making soft-fork testing easier on test networks (benthecarman, instagibbs, sedited, fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: changes -acceptnonstdtxn beyond historical Knots behavior (luke-jr)
Minor open suggestions on failure logging and moving an internal assertion (instagibbs, fjahr)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it helps developers test experimental scripts in testnet mempools
Testnet-only policy improvement that is reasonably deferrable
